concerns.text: T016 enforces a hard halt if property count < 15, directly contradicting the amended scope (N=2-3) defined in spec.md and plan.md. This task will cause the pipeline to fail immediately upon execution with valid data, violating the requirement to process the available N=2-3 properties.

T036 claims to update spec.md to reflect N=2-3, but the provided spec.md text still explicitly retains 'N >= 15' in FR-001 and SC-001. The task description assumes the amendment is complete without verifying the spec text has actually been modified, creating a semantic gap between the task and the requirement.

T035 creates an amendment record for deviating from Constitution Principle VII (10 subsets/3 seeds), but the Constitution itself (FR-030) remains unamended. A task creating a local note does not satisfy the constitutional requirement to amend the governing document for a deviation of this magnitude.

T025 and T026 implement 'spatial locality' and 'symmetry sensitivity' without defining the concrete formulas or derivation logic required by SC-004. The tasks describe the *intent* but lack the specific implementation details to satisfy the acceptance criterion of computing valid correlation coefficients.

T042 proposes an exact permutation test for N=2 vs N=3 (10 permutations), but fails to address the mathematical impossibility of achieving p < 0.05 with only 10 permutations (min p=0.1). This task cannot satisfy the success criterion of p < 0.05, rendering the statistical validation requirement unachievable.
